dimensions.note: Strict public source contract and recursive denylist reject credentials and identifying content.
normalizeSnapshot has no entry or completion logging.
Schema, leakage, freshness, and bounds failures occur before persistence.
Tests cover leakage, credentials, URLs, IPs, source identity, sensitivity, stale evidence, bounds contract, and zero authority.
A reused snapshotId can overwrite a different prior snapshot without a conflict check.
No external API calls or collection.
Published material and fixture use synthetic provider-neutral data.
Persisted snapshot and nested contracts are strict with hard row, byte, window, group, evidence, and text bounds.
The sole writer prefixes validated snapshotId consistently.
No readResource replay/conflict check is performed for snapshotId.
